top_signals.title: U.S. retreat from global order ‘eroding’ European competitiveness, central bank boss warns
top_signals.summary: ECB chief Christine Lagarde called for better integration across the region if Europe wants to compete in the age of AI.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Trump announces 'economic warfare' on Iran, threatens ‘tremendous’ consequences for its backers
top_signals.summary: The announcement extends a pressure campaign the Trump administration has waged since April under the banner Operation Economic Fury.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin, ether surge as Trump urges Congress to pass crypto Clarity Act
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin and ether surged after U.S. President Donald Trump urged Congress to pass a bill that would set a regulatory framework for the cryptocurrency sector.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
